name: London City Airport
title: London City Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: London City is small, close to central London and on the DLR. Here's who flies from it and how to get there.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.airlines: British Airways (BA CityFlyer), KLM and a handful of others
terminals.text: A single, compact terminal. It's quick to get through, but small, so the airport asks you not to arrive more than 2 hours before your flight.

sections.heading: Getting to London City Airport
sections.text:
- **DLR:** London City Airport has its own DLR station next to the terminal, about 20 minutes from Bank. Change at Canning Town for the Jubilee and Elizabeth lines.
- **Elizabeth line:** to Custom House, then a short DLR hop or taxi.
- **Car and taxi:** there's a drop-off area outside the terminal, though the DLR is usually quicker at busy times.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from London City Airport?
faqs.answer: British Airways (BA CityFlyer) is the biggest, plus KLM and a few others.

faqs.question: Is there a station at London City Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes, the DLR station is right next to the terminal.
